steps.solve:
cd $R/blueprint
terraform init
sed -i 's/lifecycle = {/lifecycle {/; s/filname /filename/' main.tf
terraform fmt
terraform validate
steps.wrong:
cd $R/blueprint
terraform init
printf 'resource "local_file" "note" {
  filename = "note.txt"
  content  = "x"
}
' > main.tf

steps.solve:
cd $R/references
sed -i 's/CHANGE-ME/${random_pet.ship.id}/' main.tf
terraform init
terraform apply -auto-approve
steps.wrong:
cd $R/references
sed -i 's/CHANGE-ME/brave-ship/' main.tf
terraform init
terraform apply -auto-approve

cd $R/layout
terraform fmt
terraform init
terraform validate

steps.solve:
cd $R/plan
terraform plan
mkdir -p $R/answers
echo local_file.replace_me > $R/answers/replaced.txt
echo local_file.delete_me > $R/answers/destroyed.txt
echo 2 > $R/answers/add.txt
steps.wrong:
mkdir -p $R/answers
echo local_file.replace_me > $R/answers/replaced.txt
echo local_file.delete_me > $R/answers/destroyed.txt
echo 1 > $R/answers/add.txt

steps.solve:
cd $R/plan
terraform plan -out=tfplan
terraform apply tfplan

cd $R/halfbuilt
terraform apply -auto-approve || true
sed -i 's#logs/today.txt#logbook/today.txt#' main.tf
terraform apply -auto-approve
steps.wrong:
cd $R/halfbuilt
sed -i 's#logs/today.txt#logbook/today.txt#' main.tf
terraform destroy -auto-approve
terraform apply -auto-approve

steps.solve:
cd $R/dismantle
$PY - <<'PY'
import re
p='main.tf'; t=open(p).read()
t=re.sub(r'resource "local_file" "old_boat" \{.*?\n\}\n?', '', t, flags=re.S)
open(p,'w').write(t)
PY
terraform apply -auto-approve

cd $R/versions
terraform init || true
terraform init -upgrade

steps.wrong:
cd $R/harbors
cat >> main.tf <<'HCL'

resource "local_file" "backup" {
  filename = "${path.module}/backup.txt"
  content  = "backup records"
}
HCL
terraform apply -auto-approve

steps.solve:
cd $R/boss
terraform init -upgrade
sed -i 's/lifecycle = {/lifecycle {/' main.tf
terraform fmt
terraform validate
terraform apply -auto-approve
steps.wrong:
cd $R/boss
rm -f .terraform.lock.hcl
sed -i 's/lifecycle = {/lifecycle {/' main.tf
terraform fmt
terraform init
terraform destroy -auto-approve
terraform apply -auto-approve
